item.title: Welcome to My Blog
item.description:
Welcome to my blog! This is a minimalist space where I share thoughts on software engineering, technology, and various topics that interest me.

I’ve built this site using Hugo, a fast and flexible static site generator, with a clean dark theme that’s easy on the eyes.

Stay tuned for more content!
